faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: What is Plooy?
items.answer: Plooy is a curated streaming platform where you can watch films, series, and documentaries from independent filmmakers around the world.

items.question: How much does Plooy cost?
items.answer: We offer monthly plans from ₺49 and an annual plan at ₺490. The annual plan includes two months free.

items.question: Where can I watch?
items.answer: Watch Plooy in your web browser, on Android, iOS, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Android TV, and Google TV. You can also add it to your TV as an app.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: Cancel anytime from the Subscription section in your account.

items.question: What can I watch on Plooy?
items.answer: Films, series, documentaries, and short films from world independent cinema.

items.question: Is Plooy suitable for children?
items.answer: Yes. A kids profile serves age-appropriate content.
